2.evidence_source: The study included "Saudi middle-aged women" and participants were "recruited from all primary health centers in Hofuf city". Hofuf city is in Saudi Arabia.
2._section_summary: This abstract describes a cross-sectional study (Study X) conducted among 326 middle-aged Saudi women in Hofuf city. The primary aim was to identify Body Appreciation (BA), Body Mass Index (BMI), and Weight Loss (WL) efforts, and the secondary aim was to test the mediation effect of BA on the association between BMI and WL. Participants had a mean age of 49.14 years and a mean BMI of 29.64, with BA found to fully mediate the relationship between BMI and WL.
